title: MeshPack Common Definitions
description: Shared type definitions referenced by manifest, shard, and sidecar schemas. Canonical source of truth for shared enums and patterns.

hashAlgorithm.description: Supported hash algorithms. sha256 is RECOMMENDED for maximum compatibility.

signer_id.description: Optional identifier of the signer (email, key ID, etc.)

importPolicy.description: Guidance for conflict handling when importing into another system

id_conflict.description: fail: reject import if ID exists; skip: keep existing, ignore incoming; overwrite: replace existing entry

metamodel_merge.description: strict: reject if metamodel structure differs; merge: add new files to existing metamodel; replace: replace entire metamodel

strip_creator_info.description: If true, importer should remove creator_info before storing

creatorInfo.description: Entity that generated the pack. PII note: email field may contain personal data — redact or hash for public distribution.

platformInfo.description: Source platform metadata for cross-platform path handling

shardReference.description: Reference to an index shard with integrity hash

metamodelRole.description: Role of a file within a metamodel grouping

assemblyRole.description: Role of a component within an assembly hierarchy

upAxis.description: Up-axis orientation of the source model

deltaOperation.description: Operation type for delta pack entries. Only present in packs where generation.partial=true.

spdxLicense.description: License of the CONTENT (not the format). SHOULD use SPDX expression syntax (e.g., 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'CC-BY-4.0'). Use 'Proprietary' for non-open-source content, 'LicenseRef-<id>' for custom licenses, or null if unknown.
